# Research success contract fixture

## Scenario

The confirmed intent is expanded through multi-path discovery, chemistry-entity
term expansion, legal full-text lookup, and the preferred PDF parser route.

## Expected outcome

The orchestrator writes a human-readable research evidence package and a layered literature set,
records covered and uncovered directions, and proposes a
Prototype handoff without stopping at a fixed paper count.

## Invariants

- OpenAlex, Semantic Scholar, and Crossref remain replaceable adapters.
- The package records uncertainties and does not treat discovery as exhaustive.
